title: In How Many Ways can a Rectangle be Rectangled?
summary: There are $2^{n-1}$ ways to tile a $1 \times n$ rectangle with rectangular tiles (of any length, of course they all must have width $1$), but in how many ways can you tile a $100 \times 100$ checkerboard with such tiles? Neither humankind, nor computer-kind, will (most probably) ever know the exact number. But it is possible to compute these numbers for $m \times n$ rectangular grids, if $m$ is not too big, while $n$ can be as big as one wishes.
